scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be registered under a government health program
Applicant must be working in a COVID-19‑designated hospital or care facility
Applicant must be directly involved in COVID-19 duties
benefits_summary: Provides an insurance cover of ₹5,000,000 for death or permanent disability due to COVID-19.
